A shrewd or calculating man
A timid or nervous man

A desert nomad in Arab countries
A city merchant in Arab countries

Guarantee the safety of
Hint in a sly manner

days.d: A slight convexity (as of the surface of a road)

A shallow rut (as made by cart wheels)

Of icy chill from a mountain wind

Young and inexperienced in life
Dutiful and obedient to elders

A grasping miser who is overly attached to his own money
